name: Proton
title: proton.me
shortDescription: Proton offers a suite of secure and privacy-focused tools including email, VPN, and cloud storage. Designed for individuals and businesses who prioritize data security, Proton ensures that user data remains private and protected. An example use case is a business using Proton Mail to secure their communications and Proton Drive to safely store sensitive documents.
pros: Strong focus on privacy and security
cons: Potentially higher cost compared to less secure alternatives
Limited third-party integrations due to security focus
Complexity in setup and management for less tech-savvy users

aiSuggestedAlternatives.name: NordVPN
aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Comparable VPN service with strong security
